Q1_transformed_variables.Psi: Psi = -i int cbar_mu (2 D^mu[h] - b^mu),  D^mu[h] = d_nu h^{mu nu} - (1/2) d^mu tr h

elimination.reading: eliminating b makes S_Psi QUADRATIC in cbar*' (and shifts the cbar*'-linear terms into h-dependent ones); retaining b keeps S_Psi linear in all external antifields

Q2_fields_antifields_b.source_spectators: cbar*' couples only via cbar*'.b (one quantum leg; tree, one-particle reducible through the b-h mixing) and b*' is absent => Gamma_1 (1PI) is independent of cbar*', b*'; K', c*', phi*' enter Gamma_1 through K'.c.h, c*'.c.c, phi*'.c.phi

Q3_1PI_vacuum_onepoint.Gamma: Gamma_Psi[Phi, Phi*'] = S_Psi + hbar Gamma_1 + O(hbar^2); Legendre transform in the fields Phi = (h, c, cbar, b, phi) only; antifields Phi*' are spectators (not transformed)
Q3_1PI_vacuum_onepoint.Gamma1: Gamma_1 = (i/2) STr log S_Psi^{(2)} (fields only) = -i log Z|_1PI; i Gamma_1 = sum of 1PI one-loop graphs (graph i's from vertices i kappa^n V and propagators i M^{-1})
Q3_1PI_vacuum_onepoint.vacuum_normalization: Z normalised so that Gamma_1[0] = 0 (field-independent vacuum graphs dropped)
Q3_1PI_vacuum_onepoint.one_point_normalization: the one-point function Gamma_1^{(1)} (graphs D14a, D14b, D14c) is RETAINED as part of the object: no tadpole-cancellation condition and no background shift imposed; its value is not assigned here (no zero is substituted)
Q3_1PI_vacuum_onepoint.background: fields of Gamma are the classical (mean) fields; <h> is not shifted

Q5_kappa_loop_bookkeeping.rule: S_Psi = sum_n kappa^n S^(n); each vertex with n legs is O(kappa^{n-2}); one loop: Gamma_1 at kappa^k has exactly k external legs (sum over vertices of (n_v - 2) = E); hbar counts loops (one loop = hbar^1)
Q5_kappa_loop_bookkeeping.orders: P.5 scope: one loop, kappa^1 (one-point) and kappa^2 (two-point incl. K'c)
